messages:
Jamal R: Window's a postcard this morning — soft snow and the tram lights. Anyone else commuting? Share snaps. Bonus for fuzzy dogs. Also, is anyone up for a 4pm lobby 5-min carol/mini-choir? :musical_note: :snowflake:
Priya K: Omg yes, sending mine. Little kid with a sled. (photo)
Sam L: Love this. Here's mine — blurry coffee steam on the glass. ☕️
Lina M: Count me in for the lobby sing. I'll bring bells. :bell:
Jamal R: @Lina M amazing. I'll coordinate rehearsal spot by the coffee station.
OfficeBot: Calendar event created — 'Lobby Mini-Choir & Cocoa' today 16:00. RSVP: https://calendar.internal/ev/197123
Priya K: Quick poll: choir + cocoa at the end or cocoa first then carols? React :chocolate: for cocoa-first, :musical_note: for carols-first
Sam L: :chocolate:
Lina M: :musical_note:
Jamal R: :chocolate: for me too. Also — extra points if someone brings a ukulele. :grin:
Tina H: Can't make it in person, but here's a tiny snow window I snapped earlier. Love the vibe — happy holiday eve, team! :heart:
Priya K: @Tina H we'll save you a mug and record a 30s clip :slightly_smiling_face:
Sam L: Bonus dog photo contest winner goes to Priya's kid + sled. :trophy:
Jamal R: Okay team — meeting spot by the main lobby bench, 15:55 for setup. See you! :raised_hands:
